title: Algerian Chicken Tagine for Hangover Cure
description: A hearty and flavorful North African stew to help alleviate hangover symptoms.

ingredients.name: algerian chicken tagine spice mix
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern or North African markets

ingredients.name: water
ingredients.notes: chicken broth and water are interchangeable

instructions: Heat the olive oil in the bottom of a clay or ceramic tagine or Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth, rice, and Algerian chicken tagine spice mix.
Bring to a boil, then cover and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the honey and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
